parameters.name: ClientIds
parameters.description: The list of backup client IDs.

parameters.name: ClientType
parameters.description:
The type of the backup client. Valid values:
- **ECS_CLIENT**: ECS File Backup client.
- **CONTAINER_CLIENT**: container backup client.
- **LOCAL_CLIENT**: local NAS backup, CPFS backup, archive, or data synchronization client.

parameters.name: ClusterId
parameters.description: The ID of the backup cluster.

parameters.name: CrossAccountRoleName
parameters.description: The name of the RAM role created in the source account for cross-account backup.

parameters.name: CrossAccountType
parameters.description:
The type of cross-account backup. Valid values: 
- SELF_ACCOUNT: backup within the current account. 
- CROSS_ACCOUNT: cross-account backup.

parameters.name: CrossAccountUserId
parameters.description: The ID of the source account used for cross-account backup.

sub_parameters.name: Key
sub_parameters.description: The key of the query filter.

sub_parameters.name: Values
sub_parameters.description: The values to match in the query filter.

parameters.name: InstanceIds
parameters.description: The list of ECS instance IDs.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number. Pages start from 1. Default value: 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Minimum value: 1. Maximum value: 99. Default value: 10.

sub_parameters.name: Key
sub_parameters.description:
The tag key of the backup vault. Valid values of N: 1 to 20.

- The tag key cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. 
- The tag key cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.
- The tag key cannot be an empty string.

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description:
The tag value of the backup vault. Valid values of N: 1 to 20.

- The tag value cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. 
- The tag value cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.
- The tag value cannot be an empty string.
